name: Use standalone components
description: Angular 17+ default; no NgModule needed
do: Standalone components for all new code

name: Use signals for state
description: Signals are Angular's reactive primitive for fine-grained reactivity
do: Signals for component state over class properties

name: Use @if/@for/@switch control flow
description: Built-in control flow syntax replaces *ngIf/*ngFor directives

name: Use input() and output() signals
description: Signal-based inputs/outputs replace @Input()/@Output() decorators
do: input() and output() for component API

name: Use content projection
description: ng-content for flexible component composition
do: ng-content with select for named slots
dont: Rigid templates that can't be customized

name: Keep components small
description: Single responsibility; components should do one thing
do: Extract sub-components when template exceeds 50 lines

name: Use OnPush change detection
description: Reduces re-renders by only checking on input changes or signal updates

name: Avoid direct DOM manipulation
description: Use renderer or ElementRef sparingly; prefer template bindings

name: Lazy load feature routes
description: Load route chunks on demand to reduce initial bundle

name: Use route guards with functional API
guideline: Use route guards with functional API
description: Protect routes with canActivate/canMatch functional guards
do: Functional guards returning boolean or UrlTree

name: Use route resolvers for data
description: Pre-fetch data before route activation using resolve
dont: Fetching data in ngOnInit causing flash of empty state
code_bad: Fetch in ngOnInit with loading state flickering

name: Type route params with inject
description: Use inject(ActivatedRoute) with signals or toSignal

name: Use nested routes for layouts
description: Compose shared layouts using router-outlet nesting
do: Nested routes with shared layout components
code_bad: Duplicate header/sidebar in each route component

name: Configure preloading strategies
description: Preload lazy modules in background after initial load

name: Use signals for local state
description: Signals provide synchronous reactive state without RxJS overhead
code_good: const items = signal<Item[]>([]); addItem(i: Item) { this.items.update(arr => [...arr i]) }

name: Use computed() for derived state
description: Lazily evaluated derived values that update when dependencies change
do: computed() for values derived from other signals
code_good: readonly total = computed(() => this.items().reduce((s i) => s + i.price 0))

name: Use effect() carefully
description: Effects run side effects when signals change; avoid overuse
do: effect() for side effects like logging or localStorage sync
dont: effect() for deriving state (use computed instead)

name: Use NgRx Signal Store for complex state
guideline: Use NgRx Signal Store for complex state
description: NgRx Signal Store is the modern lightweight state management for Angular
dont: Full NgRx reducer/action/effect boilerplate for simple state
code_good: const Store = signalStore(withState({ count: 0 }) withMethods(s => ({ increment: () => patchState(s { count: s.count() + 1 }) })))

name: Inject services for shared state
description: Services with signals share state across components without a store
do: Injectable service with signals for cross-component state
dont: Prop drilling or @Input chains for shared state

name: Avoid mixing RxJS and signals unnecessarily
guideline: Avoid mixing RxJS and signals unnecessarily
description: Use toSignal() to bridge RxJS into signal world at the boundary
do: toSignal() to convert observable to signal at component edge
dont: Subscribing in components and storing in signal manually

name: Use typed reactive forms
description: FormGroup/FormControl with explicit generics for compile-time safety

name: Use reactive forms over template-driven
description: Reactive forms scale better and are fully testable
dont: FormsModule with ngModel for complex forms

name: Write custom validators as functions
description: Functional validators are composable and tree-shakeable
code_good: const noSpaces: ValidatorFn = ctrl => ctrl.value?.includes(' ') ? { noSpaces: true } : null

name: Use updateOn for performance
description: Control when validation runs to avoid per-keystroke validation overhead

name: Use FormArray for dynamic fields
description: FormArray manages variable-length lists of controls
code_good: get items(): FormArray { return this.form.get('items') as FormArray }

name: Display validation errors clearly
description: Use form control touched and dirty states to show errors at the right time
do: Show errors after field is touched
dont: Show all errors on page load

name: Apply OnPush to all components
description: OnPush + signals eliminates most unnecessary change detection cycles
dont: Default strategy which checks entire tree on every event

name: Use trackBy in @for blocks
description: Stable identity for list items prevents full DOM re-creation on change

name: Use @defer for below-the-fold content
description: Defer blocks lazy-load components when they enter the viewport
do: @defer with on viewport for non-critical UI
dont: Eagerly loading all components at startup

name: Use NgOptimizedImage
description: Enforces image best practices: lazy loading LCP hints and proper sizing
dont: Plain img tags for CMS or user content

name: Tree-shake unused Angular features
description: Import only what you use from Angular packages
dont: Import BrowserAnimationsModule when not using animations

name: Avoid subscribe in components
description: Subscriptions leak and cause bugs; prefer async pipe or toSignal
do: toSignal() or async pipe instead of manual subscribe
dont: Manual subscribe without unsubscribe in ngOnDestroy

name: Use SSR with Angular Universal
description: Pre-render pages for faster LCP and better SEO
do: SSR or SSG for public-facing routes
code_bad: // no SSR, client renders empty shell

name: Minimize bundle with standalone APIs
description: Standalone components + provideRouter() eliminate dead NgModule code

name: Use TestBed for component tests
description: TestBed sets up Angular DI for realistic component testing

name: Use Angular CDK component harnesses
description: Harnesses provide a stable testing API that survives template refactors
dont: Direct native element queries that break on template changes

name: Use Spectator for less boilerplate
description: Spectator wraps TestBed with a cleaner API reducing test setup noise

name: Mock services with jasmine.createSpyObj
description: Isolate unit tests by providing mock implementations of dependencies
do: SpyObj or jest.fn() mocks for services
dont: Real HTTP calls in unit tests
code_bad: providers: [UserService] // real service in unit test

name: Write integration tests for routes
description: Test full route navigation including guards and resolvers
dont: Mock all routing behavior in unit tests
code_good: const harness = await RouterTestingHarness.create(); await harness.navigateByUrl('/home')

name: Test signal-based components
description: Signals update synchronously; no async flush needed in most cases
do: Read signal value directly in test assertions
dont: TestBed.tick() or fakeAsync for signal reads

name: Use ViewEncapsulation.Emulated
description: Default emulation scopes styles to component preventing global leaks
do: Emulated or None for intentional global styles

name: Use :host selector
description: Style the component's host element using :host pseudo-class
dont: Adding wrapper div just for styling

name: Use CSS custom properties for theming
guideline: Use CSS custom properties for theming
description: CSS variables work across component boundaries and enable dynamic theming
do: CSS custom properties for colors and spacing
dont: Hardcoded hex values in component styles

name: Integrate Tailwind with Angular
description: Tailwind utilities work alongside Angular's ViewEncapsulation via global stylesheet
do: Add Tailwind in styles.css and use utility classes in templates
dont: Custom CSS for layout that Tailwind already handles

name: Use Angular Material theming tokens
description: Material 3 uses design tokens for systematic theming
do: M3 token-based theming for Angular Material
dont: Overriding Angular Material CSS with deep selectors

name: Use injection tokens for config
description: Provide configuration via InjectionToken for testability and flexibility
code_good: const API_URL = new InjectionToken<string>('apiUrl'); provide: [{ provide: API_URL useValue: env.apiUrl }]

name: Use HTTP interceptors
description: Intercept requests for auth headers error handling and logging
dont: Service-level header management in every request
code_bad: httpClient.get(url { headers: { Authorization: token } }) in every call

name: Organize by feature not type
description: Feature-based folder structure scales better than type-based
do: Feature folders with collocated component service and routes

name: Use environment configurations
description: Separate environment values for dev staging and prod via Angular build configs
dont: Hardcoded API URLs or feature flags in source

name: Prefer inject() over constructor DI
description: inject() function is composable and works in more contexts than constructor injection
code_good: readonly http = inject(HttpClient); readonly router = inject(Router)
code_bad: constructor(private http: HttpClient private router: Router) {}
